adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, blacklist entries are normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` string is compared without normalization: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Since the input schema only validates email format (`z.string().email()`) and does not lowercase, a case-variant email (e.g., `Bad@Example.com`) could bypass the blacklist and be added/emailed.
